presentation.summary: Fetch and submit intro, credits, recap, and preview markers through TheIntroDB.
presentation.description_markdown: Adds community-maintained playback markers from TheIntroDB to movies and TV episodes. It can fetch markers without an account and can submit corrections or new markers when an API key is configured.
presentation.setup_markdown: Install the plugin and enable **TheIntroDB** as a marker provider. Fetching works without configuration. To submit markers or view account statistics, add an API key from your account at **theintrodb.org**. IntroDB (introdb.app) is a different service, and its keys are rejected with `401 Invalid or expired token`. A key also raises the daily lookup budget, which helps large libraries. Submissions are credited to the account that owns the key.
